name: Cryptid Courting
source:
After Amira Love lost her job as a doctor after she did something she wasn't supposed to do, she's now stuck in a whole new world she never thought existed. Luckily though, she has a new job lined up for her new life, one at a...cryptid dating agency????? 

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230128093734/https://llonelly.itch.io/cryptid-courting]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿米拉·洛芙做了不该做的事，失去了医生的工作，如今又受困于一个从未想过存在的全新世界。不过，幸运的是，新生活中的工作已经安排好了，就在一家……神秘生物婚恋介绍所？？？？？

[编译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230128093734/https://llonelly.itch.io/cryptid-courting]itch.io[/url]]
